$comment: YOFO Review's own contract (ADR 0014, plan 2026-10-01-standalone-review-app): the review bridge (crates/mib-bridge/src/review_bridge.rs, review_shim.cpp) and the YOFO Review shell. Separate from bridge-contract.json, the MIB Studio backend bridge ABI, which it never changes. C++ ties to these values via static_asserts in review_shim.cpp; Rust via tests/review_bridge.rs; TypeScript via the generated desktop/src/review/reviewContract.ts and desktop/src-tauri/src/review_packet_contract.rs (scripts/gen_bridge_contract.py --check fails CI on drift). Additive changes only: append values, never renumber or repurpose.

frame_packet.base: bridge-contract.json frame_packet: the same magic, version, header layout, byte order and limits
frame_packet.identity_semantics: capture_session and store_generation are zero: review frames come from a recorded file, not a capture
frame_packet.rgb8_semantics: review pulls (kinds 3, 5, 6) may carry RGB8 (3 bytes per pixel, stride = width*3) when the backend composed an overlay or ROI; mono pulls are unchanged
frame_packet.thumbnail_strip_semantics: pull kind 5 packs count tiles of size x size as one frame of width size and height size*count; frame_index = page offset

review_density.ramp_semantics: backend/processing/MonitoringDensity.h densityRampColor: linear interpolation over the stops, t in [0,1]; level k of n uses t = k/(n-1) (kdeLevelColor)
